proper_name_policy: Picture-locked identity data, not lexical/spelling targets. A learner's actual name or a chosen pictured role is accepted in personal responses. No knowledge of the meaning or spelling of an English name is assumed.
instruction_policy: No English instruction verb is load-bearing. Six action icons are bootstrapped by the five actual nonverbal action sequences in actions.svg, with worked responses before each task family. Numerals and shape matching are non-language conventions demonstrated visually, not English counting targets.

reference_exemptions.headings: NOT exempt: actual learner headings use only symbols, IDs or already-taught words, and all rendered heading words/images are checked at the point of use. The 21 template functions are mapped by number in the internal delivery guide.
reference_exemptions.blockquote: Coded level/module/unit/lesson sequence only; no new English words or task direction.
reference_exemptions.summary: The technical SCRIPT ONLY — no audio recording disclosure notice and the key-uncover tick are helper/navigation labels, not load-bearing learner instructions. The actual helper-reading picture independently demonstrates what happens.
reference_exemptions.image_alt_and_svg_title_desc: English accessibility/helper descriptions of the actual supplied images, not an alternative zero-English route. Rendered SVG text is separately inventory-checked at each use. The pilot is visual-dependent and has not been tested for screen-reader-only use.
reference_exemptions.html_comments: Template machine record and introduction/reading markers; hidden, not student dialogue or instructions. English-only guard still scans them.
reference_exemptions.ipa: Exact registered IPA and /ɡʊd/, /b/ fragments in sound diagrams; optional reference, never a learner prerequisite or assessment target. Visual mouths alone cannot supply all speech sounds.

G003.scope: I/you singular with an explicitly pictured speaker and listener.
G003.not_yet_taught: he/she/it/we/they; alphabet knowledge is not a prerequisite.

G004.scope: Only I am/You are + a personal identity label, as one main affirmative identity frame.
G004.not_yet_taught: it is; non-identity complements; contractions as taught forms; negatives G008; yes/no questions G009.

G011.scope: Only my/your + name; the main new frame is My/Your name is + identity.

G010.scope: Only the explicitly taught whole chunk What is your name?, plus its taught identity responses. This is not a generative wh-question rule.
G010.not_yet_taught: Who/Where questions; other What questions; productive inversion.

rubric_definitions.greet: hello or hi in a meeting; all natural case/punctuation variants accepted
rubric_definitions.leave: goodbye or bye on departure, optionally with the visible identity label
rubric_definitions.self: I am + the speaker's identity; actual learner identity or pictured role; a natural contraction is acceptable if independently produced, but is not taught or required
rubric_definitions.you-tom: You are Tom, addressed to the pictured listener; the communicative frame is scored, not copying the name's spelling
rubric_definitions.name-self: My name is + the speaker's identity; actual identity or pictured role
rubric_definitions.name-you-tom: Your name is Tom, with Tom as the listener in the picture
rubric_definitions.name-question: An intelligible What is your name? request. A naturally produced contraction is also acceptable, although not modeled. Speed and accent are not scored
rubric_definitions.name-answer: My name is + identity, I am + identity, or the bare identity label is a natural answer. The bare label is communicatively correct but is not evidence of using the new frame
rubric_definitions.dialogue-l01: Follow the displayed role exchange, including greeting, both identity frames and taking leave; either taught greeting/farewell variant is acceptable
rubric_definitions.personal-dialogue-l01: Greeting + I am + own/role identity + farewell; no model name is required
rubric_definitions.dialogue-l02: Both roles in the displayed name/badge exchange; whole question, both My name is answers and appropriate Your name is confirmations
rubric_definitions.personal-dialogue-l02: Whole name request + My name is + own/role identity
rubric_definitions.copy: Copy the complete displayed model; no independent spelling or punctuation knowledge is assumed
rubric_definitions.self-anna: I am Anna in the pictured role, not the learner's own identity
rubric_definitions.two-be-gaps: I takes am and you takes are, in that order
rubric_definitions.name-link-gap: is links name and identity; not am or are
rubric_definitions.question-link-gap: is in the already-taught fixed name question

assessment_policy.rounding: ceil(0.70 * 8) = 6; no claim that 6/8 is exactly 70%
assessment_policy.speaking_evidence: Q07 needs a competent listener and retained observation/recording. Without evidence, Q07 is not assessed and no complete total or pass is recorded. No learner results currently exist.
assessment_policy.retake: Same-item repairs are practice only. No scored retake is offered before a parallel form exists.
